subject: Supplier onboarding: tax signatory clarification & PO timing
messages:

Cc: accounts@starlumen.io
Date: 2026-11-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Completed tax form for Redwood onboarding

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist. Attached is our completed W-8BEN-E — we filled the form as we were previously classified as a non-US entity in our global records. The form is signed by our CFO, Anil Verma, but the signer block doesn't specify "Authorized Representative" (we used the standard corporate signature block). Apologies if that causes any extra steps on your side.

Our accounts team also included a company tax letter confirming our status and the EIN for our US subsidiary. If you need a different signer format or a board resolution, let me know and I can escalate.

Also can you advise when you typically issue the initial PO once tax docs are accepted? We are trying to schedule the first invoice.

Attachments: W-8BEN-E_Starlumen_signed.pdf (pdf)
             Company_Tax_Letter_Starlumen.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Priya Singh
Head of Finance Operations
Starlumen Inc.
priya@starlumen.io

From: rachel_kim@redwood.com
To: Priya Singh <priya@starlumen.io>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-28T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Completed tax form for Redwood onboarding

Hi Priya — thanks for sending these so quickly and for the note. A couple quick items on our side:

- We received the W-8BEN-E and the company tax letter. On first pass it looks like Starlumen may have a US-registered entity; if that's the case we usually need a W-9 rather than a W-8. Can you confirm the exact legal entity name and EIN you want on the PO?

- The signature by your CFO should be fine, but procurement will ask for clear evidence of signatory authority if the signature block doesn't state the title explicitly. The company tax letter helps — thank you for that. If you have a brief statement on letterhead confirming Anil Verma is authorised to sign on behalf of the US subsidiary that generally closes the loop.

- Laura and Marcus looped in — Laura for procurement acceptance and PO timing, Marcus for commercial kickoff and invoicing cadence.

If it's easier, you can re-upload a W-9 (if applicable) or a short incumbency/authorization PDF. Either way we'll prioritize once we have the EIN and confirmed entity name.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Vendor Onboarding Coordinator
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com

             Incumbency_AnilVerma_notarized.pdf (pdf)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Cc: Priya Singh <priya@starlumen.io>, accounts@starlumen.io
Date: 2026-11-29T10:41:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: tax signatory clarification & PO timing

Thanks, Priya and Rachel — I reviewed the W-9 and the incumbency letter. The documents are sufficient for our tax team to validate the EIN and signatory authority. Two operational notes: 

1) Please confirm the exact remit-to address and the invoice email (accounts@starlumen.io works) so AP has the correct routing.
2) Our standard commercial terms for this engagement (per DEAl-4782) are Net 30 from invoice receipt. We can expedite the first PO for onboarding if staging is required — confirm you can accept a PO with the entity name "Starlumen US LLC" and EIN 12-3456789.

Marcus: can you confirm whether the customer success kickoff can happen next week once the PO is issued?

Priya — once we have the remit-to and confirmation, I'll raise PO-4782 and send the portal invite for vendor banking info. Expect the PO within 1 business day after I raise it.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Date: 2026-11-30T15:24:00-08:00

Next steps for vendor: please complete the vendor portal onboarding at the link below and provide banking details so we can set up electronic payment. Once the portal is complete, first payment is scheduled for 30 days after invoice receipt per Net 30 terms.

Attachment: PO-4782_Starlumen_Redwood.pdf (pdf)
Vendor portal: https://vendorportal.redwood.com/setup/starlumen-4782

Thanks,
